name: repository-savior
description: Migrates archived Mercurial and SVN repositories into native Git and publishes them to GitHub as PRIVATE repositories only. Ships the orchestrating persona, fifteen narrow migration skills, a private-only GitHub command gateway, and a read-only source fingerprinting gateway. Visibility is not configurable: the only publication policy is PRIVATE_ONLY, enforced by schema, gateway, post-creation verification, and tests. Requires an explicit migration-root argument - it never writes anywhere you did not name.
